studies.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: next art-direction study for Updraft's drowned village, landscape 16:9.
Input image is the current APPROVED PAINTING. Make a carefully considered alternative, preserving its low viewpoint BEHIND the small rounded wooden boat sailing away, the positions and sizes of the boat, church spire, white lighthouse, drowned cottage roofs and bare trees. Preserve the rounded stern and white rudder nearest the camera, the little lantern, whole red sail in frame. No added objects, no people or animals.
Explore the moment when the last warm light is leaving this drowned village, just before the storm later in the story. Intimate and tender, quietly mysterious, still beautiful and inviting rather than frightening.
Two connected refinements:
1. The red scarf sail is catching a small breath of wind: give it a gentle convex belly, with long softly curved tension folds running from its corners. Keep the simple tall tapering quadrilateral silhouette, same mast and boom. It is matte wool cloth, soft brick red, warmly translucent at only the thinnest sunlit edge. Not a hanging pleated curtain, not satin, not a glossy synthetic sail. Smooth painted colour and a subtly irregular hem, no yarn stitches or repeated texture.
2. Colour has more room to breathe: keep apricot and pale gold light close to the left horizon and a warm rim on the boat; let the upper sky and shaded water take on smoky lavender and soft blue. Quiet the bright orange reflections across the whole frame into a few long warm paths among broad still cool water. Leave the red sail and lantern as precious warm notes. The village recedes through soft dusk haze; nearest roofs retain legible shapes. Keep the lightness and clarity of the approved painting.
Rendering: polished painted animation background, organic soft colour transitions, simple dimensional forms, selective crisp edges. Broad asymmetrical clouds, spaced reflections, no global texture overlay, no grids, no grain, no repeated small marks or stippling. Retain the naturally shaded lower centre for separately added Continue text. Do not flatten into vector art or make a photographic render. No text, no UI, no watermark.
studies.assessment: Same composition, cooler dusk and wind-filled sail. Alternative, not selected.

studies.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one finished chapter painting for Updraft, a quiet dreamlike game. Wide landscape 16:9. A small rounded wooden boat with a red scarf for a sail drifts AWAY from us into a drowned village at the last light of day. No people or animals visible.
This is a hand-painted animated-film background: luminous, dimensional, simple forms, soft atmospheric perspective, beautifully restrained detail. Smooth digital paint with no paper grain or surface texture. It is not a photographic water simulation or a detailed 3D render.
Low camera just above water, looking at the rounded STERN of the departing boat; small white rudder blade hangs off that stern toward us. The boat is left of centre, close enough to be the clear subject, with six broad curved wood strakes, cream gunwale, a tiny warm lantern farther forward, a stout mast and low boom. Single tall red scarf sail tapers toward the top, still a quadrilateral, not a triangle. A soft gently billowing mass of brick red with two broad curved folds, warmly lit edge, matte wool suggested only by its soft silhouette. No knit pattern, ribbing, fine fibres, fabric grain or sharp pleats.
The village feels intimate: several uneven clusters of small cottage gables and chimney pots submerged to the roof, some near and some lost in haze. One nearer slate rooftop enters the right edge, breaking the frame; a modest distant church spire to the right of the boat and a slender white lighthouse farther right. Bare tree crowns rise out of the water in a couple of places. No land or mountains or extra objects. Let the little boat have a clearly open path through the rooftops; avoid an evenly spaced lineup of identical triangular roofs.
The sunset is quieter and more poignant than a golden postcard: a low pale apricot glow at left, rose air near the horizon, great broad lavender cloud masses overhead. Muted blue-violet water holds long soft vertical reflections, gently broken in a few places. The red sail and warm lantern are the small heart of the picture. Plenty of calm space between light shapes. Not gloomy, not desaturated, no harsh black shadows. Softly shaded lower foreground water flows naturally out of the scene, suitable for a separate Continue button.
Use very few purposeful ripple marks. No stippling, crosshatching, all-over grain, repeating ripples, stamped cloudlets, grid, checkers, checkerboard shading, triangulated facets, canvas texture, watermarks, lettering, UI, borders. Distinctive beautiful painting, clear focal boat, emotionally quiet.
studies.assessment: Intermediate fresh composition; mast cropped. Corrected in 05.

studies.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input is a drowned village chapter painting. Correct the boat's framing and scale ONLY. Preserve all colours, light, sky, village buildings, trees, roofs, water character, painted rendering and low rear viewpoint.
The top of the mast and sail are currently cropped off. Redraw the SAME BOAT AND RIG as a slightly smaller coherent unit, about 80 percent of their current size, keeping the stern's bottom at roughly its current waterline and the boat in the same left-of-centre position. The mast top must now end around 18 percent down from the top edge, with clear sky above it, so it survives a widescreen crop. The entire sail, mast and rounded stern must be visible. Keep the gentle wind-filled red sail shape and smooth matte wool colour, stout cream gunwale, little lantern, broad curved wood strakes, and small white stern rudder. Correct the reflection to match the resized boat.
The boat must remain seen from behind, travelling away between the rooftops. Preserve the nearby roof entering the right edge and the depth of the village. No other new objects, no people or animals, no extra texture, no grain or grid, no text or UI. Output same landscape aspect ratio.
studies.assessment: Fresh composition revised to include full mast. Closer roofs provide a clearer passage through the village; rig differs more from the game. Alternative, not selected.
